name: Alcon
source:
Possessing supernatural ability since birth, he calls himself a demon. A classic example of false hospitality, he uses polite language but essentially mocks humans. He always maintains a calm demeanor and hardly ever lets his emotions show.

[Translated from [url=https://www.saibunkan.co.jp/scramble/jin/rena/other.html]Scramble HOUSE's official website[/url]]
